name: folio
title: Folio
description: A résumé site on white paper in graphite ink with one steel-blue accent: a hire-me page plus an experience record that is the CV, drawn as a sheet on screen and printed onto a single sheet of A4.

tokens.--font-body: the typeface for everything: the plain sans-serif already on the visitor's device, as on a typed CV
tokens.--font-mono: the fixed-width typeface for code and keyboard keys
tokens.--text-xs: smallest text: the small capital labels (Skills, Experience, 404) and the A4 mark
tokens.--text-s: small text: dates, places, the menu, the footer, contact lines
tokens.--text-l: job titles, the name in the side column, opening sentences
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the name at the top of the CV
tokens.--leading-body: space between lines of running text
tokens.--leading-tight: space between lines of a heading
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capital labels
tokens.--tracking-tight: letter spacing of headings and names (slightly closed up)
tokens.--color-bg: the paper: the background of every page
tokens.--color-sheet: the CV sheet itself: the same white as the page by day, one step lighter than the page at night
tokens.--color-text: graphite ink: body text and headings
tokens.--color-muted: lighter ink: dates, places, company names, small labels
tokens.--color-accent: the one steel-blue: links, the A4 mark, the Print button, focus rings
tokens.--color-border: thin dividing lines and the edge of the CV sheet
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code and keyboard keys
tokens.--color-mark: highlight colour when text is selected
tokens.--rail-width: width of the side column with the name, contact details and skills
tokens.--sheet-width: width of the CV sheet on a wide screen
tokens.--date-width: width of the date column on the CV
tokens.--space-3: normal gap, and the page's side margin on a phone
tokens.--space-5: gap above a page title, and the margin inside the CV sheet
tokens.--space-6: largest gap: between the side column and the content, and below the content
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the button, images and code (small: a document has square edges)
